change: Actual SketchRaster detached executor publishes immutable dirty tiles into an owner-thread display copy. QML pollDeferredResearch consumes completed revisions without draining the worker or reading mutable worker pixels.
scope: Default disabled; no raw pen routing, commit to live page, application installation or release.

transport.publication: Every submitted segment; first publication scans full image to initialize non-white pages, subsequent publications use conservative material footprint bounds.
transport.ownership: One producer and one owner-thread consumer; each enable creates a fresh transport. Stop drains and joins before discarding display and transport.
transport.locking: Poll takes a short mailbox mutex, not wait-free. It never waits for the material queue to drain. Lifecycle stop and explicit diagnostic digest remain blocking.

checks: Blocked executor still permits poll of initial display
Interleaved slow polling reconstructs exact independent-reference final image
QML Timer consumes actual backend revisions monotonically to 1260
Live image, material, finger and checked physics remain unchanged
Live PNG/cache save and reopen isolation, release/reset/begin/load/destruction barriers

limitations: QML Timer polling is not RasterTile painting, physical stylus or panel validation
No claim of actual painting latency or throughput improvement
Every-segment tile publication may add substantial copy/scan overhead; pacing needs measurement
Loaded non-white first-scan behavior implemented but not a dedicated regression scenario in this run
Only charcoal 4/5 accepted; full raw input, undo, page and commit protocol remain future work
Generated RCC excluded from research source commit; this branch is not an installable release
